name: Elphidran Aqua
description: (Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:water)A pale water dragon, gentle by nature and dreadful when roused, that swims as easily as it flies and can be ridden as a flying mount. Its breath soaks armour in clinging brine, it strengthens water magic used near it, and where its kin breathe fire it calls down healing rain instead.
